title: LLM-based Semantic Augmentation for Harmful Content Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-label classification performance (F1-score and ROC-AUC metrics) on the 'identity hate' category within the Google Jigsaw Toxic Comments dataset.

bias_targets.target: Hateful stereotypes and prejudice (e.g., racism, xenophobia, Islamophobia)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating binary classification performance on the Facebook Hateful Memes dataset, utilizing LLM-generated trigger words and explanations to explicitly identify and highlight prejudiced themes and bigoted language within multimodal inputs.
